fields.recovery_full_pct: energy recovered, fitted and scored on the full year 2024 (in-sample)
fields.corr_full: hourly correlation with AEMO rooftop PV, all hours, full year
fields.corr_daylight_full: hourly correlation, daylight hours only, full year
fields.recovery_oddeven_pct: held-out: fitted on odd months, scored on even months
fields.corr_oddeven: hourly correlation on the held-out even months
fields.naive_recovery_full_pct: naive midday-dip method (no irradiance), full year
